ObjectName.value: Ho Chi Minh City Skyline at Night

ImageDescription.value: The image captures the vibrant and illuminated skyline of Ho Chi Minh City (formerly known as Saigon) at night. Prominent skyscrapers from left to right, including the IFC One Saigon, Ho Chi Minh City Customs Department Building, Bitexco Office Building, Harbour View Tower, Osic Building, Bitexco Financial Tower, Liberty Central Saigon Riverside Hotel, Renaissance Riverside Hotel Saigon, Melinh Point Tower, Saigon Times Square, Hilton Saigon Hotel, Vietcombank Tower, Saigon Centre, Sheraton Grand Opera Saigon Hotel, The Landmark, Saigon Riverside Office Center, Lotte Hotel Saigon and some significant low-rise buildings Hotel Majestic, Seaprodex 2-4-6 Đồng Khởi, Riverside Hotel, Trần Hưng Đạo statue at Mê Linh Square, IBC Building, Vietnam People's Naval Army Barracks, Tôn Đức Thắng Museum
